```{r}
genes <- c("CD5","CD7","TRBC1","TRBC2","CD99", "CD1A")

lineage_colors <- c(

  "AML Patient"      = "#FF9896",  # light red

  "B ALL Cell Line"  = "#1F77B4",  # blue = B-lineage malignant
  "B ALL Patient"    = "#AEC7E8",  # light blue

  "T ALL Patient"    = "#98DF8A",  # light green

  "T Cells"          = "#9EDAE5",  # light teal = normal T-lineage

  "Granulocytes"     = "#FF7F0E",  # orange = normal myeloid
```

```{r}
plot_violin <- function(data,
                         x_var,
                         y_var,
                         facet_var = NULL,
                         y_label = "log2(quantile-normalized intensity)",
                         colors = vibrant_colors,
                         test_method = "wilcox.test") {
  
  p <- data %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = .data[[x_var]], y = .data[[y_var]], fill = .data[[x_var]])) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.75, linewidth = 0.5, color = "black") +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, fill = "white", outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.06, size = 0.9, alpha = 0.5, color = "black") +
    stat_compare_means(
      method = test_method,
      label = "p.signif",
      size = 7,
      label.x.npc = 0.5,
      label.y.npc = 0.95,
      hjust = 0.5
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = y_label, fill = x_var) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13, base_family = "Helvetica") +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, size = 10),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, margin = margin(r = 8)),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    )
  
  if (!is.null(facet_var)) {
    p <- p + facet_wrap(vars(.data[[facet_var]]), scales = "free_y")
  }
  
  p
}
```

```{r}
get_geo_expression_data <- function(gse_id,
                                     platform_idx = 1,
                                     gene_assign_col = "gene_assignment",
                                     pheno_cols = NULL) {
  
  ## 1. Pull the series
  gse <- getGEO(gse_id, GSEMatrix = TRUE)[[platform_idx]]
  
  ## 2. Extract expression matrix, phenotype, and annotation
  expr_mat <- exprs(gse)
  pheno    <- pData(gse) %>% rownames_to_column("sample")
  anno     <- fData(gse) %>% rownames_to_column("probe_id")
  
  if (!is.null(pheno_cols)) {
    pheno <- pheno %>% select(sample, all_of(pheno_cols))
  }
  
  ## 3. Keep only real gene probes, extract gene symbol(s) per probe
  anno_main <- anno %>%
    filter(category == "main") %>%
    mutate(
      gene_symbol = map_chr(.data[[gene_assign_col]], ~ {
        if (is.na(.x) || .x == "" || .x == "---") return(NA_character_)
        entries <- str_split(.x, "\\s*///\\s*")[[1]]
        symbols <- map_chr(entries, ~ {
          parts <- str_split(.x, "\\s*//\\s*")[[1]]
          if (length(parts) >= 2) trimws(parts[2]) else NA_character_
        })
        symbols <- unique(symbols[!is.na(symbols) & symbols != "---"])
        if (length(symbols) == 0) NA_character_ else paste(symbols, collapse = "/")
      })
    ) %>%
    select(probe_id, gene_symbol) %>%
    separate_rows(gene_symbol, sep = "/")
  
  ## 4. Collapse any remaining duplicate probe_id rows into one row per probe
  anno_collapsed <- anno_main %>%
    group_by(probe_id) %>%
    summarise(gene_symbol = paste(unique(gene_symbol), collapse = "/"), .groups = "drop")
  
  ## 5. Reshape expression to long: probe_id | sample | value
  expr_long <- expr_mat %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("probe_id") %>%
    pivot_longer(-probe_id, names_to = "sample", values_to = "value")
  
  ## 6. Attach gene symbols
  expr_long <- expr_long %>%
    left_join(anno_collapsed, by = "probe_id")
  
  ## 7. Merge with phenotype
  merged <- expr_long %>%
    left_join(pheno, by = "sample")
  
  ## 8. Sanity checks
  stopifnot(nrow(merged) == nrow(expr_long))
  message(sprintf("%d samples, %d probes, %d total rows",
                   ncol(expr_mat), nrow(expr_mat), nrow(merged)))
  message(sprintf("%d / %d rows have no gene symbol match",
                   sum(is.na(merged$gene_symbol)), nrow(merged)))
  
  merged
}

GSE48558 <- get_geo_expression_data("GSE48558",
                                    pheno_cols = c("description", 
                                                   "phenotype:ch1"))
```

```{r}
merged_clean <- merged %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene_symbol)) %>%
  filter(gene_symbol %in% genes) %>%
  select(
    probe_id,
    gene_symbol,
    sample,
    value,
    title,
    source_name_ch1,
    organism_ch1,
    `characteristics_ch1`,
    `phenotype:ch1`
  )

merged_clean <- merged_clean %>% select(!probe_id)

merged %>%
  distinct(gene_symbol) %>%
  filter(str_detect(gene_symbol, "CD5|CD7|TRBC|CD99"))

plot_violin(
  data = merged_clean,
  x_var = "phenotype:ch1",
  y_var = "value",
  facet_var = "gene_symbol"
)
```
